role: Split out of WatchConnectivityBridge.swift: the bridge's user-info queueing rule (transferLatestUserInfo / userInfoSupersedes, used by the dual-channel commands, the voice-chat state and the coach-alert haptic), WatchControlRefusal (why the phone refused a Watch control message, and its phone-language wording) and WatchSendTimeoutBreaker (the live-state send-timeout circuit breaker's state).
types: WatchControlRefusal: enum (String raw, Sendable) — reason codes for refusing Watch control messages; the raw value travels as `errorCode`
WatchSendTimeoutBreaker: struct (Sendable, Equatable) — send-timeout circuit-breaker state: opens at 3 timeouts for a 30 s cooldown
toplevel: No stored state of its own. WatchSendTimeoutBreaker declares static threshold = 3 and cooldown = 30 s. The superseding rule names its types by MessageType raw values plus the literal "voiceChatState".

units.does: Cancels every outstanding user-info transfer whose type the new payload's type supersedes (userInfoSupersedes), then queues the payload with transferUserInfo, so the Watch receives at most the newest workout start/stop, strap state, voice-chat state and coach alert when it next runs.

Pure rule: false when either type is nil; a startWorkout or stopWorkout supersedes a queued startWorkout or stopWorkout; a strapState, voiceChatState or coachAlert supersedes a queued one of the same type; any other type supersedes nothing, and none of these supersedes another type.

branches.effect: type is strapState/voiceChatState/coachAlert and queued == type

units.does: Returns the refusal text in the phone's app language for each WatchControlRefusal case (unknownSport quotes the sport string or '').

branches.effect: 'Unknown sport: <sport>' with empty string when sport is nil
'Open Emuqu on your iPhone to start your free trial or unlock.'
'The strap is currently used by another session. Stop it first.'
'A workout is already recording on your iPhone.'

units.does: True when the timeout count has reached threshold (3), the breaker has an openedAt, and less than cooldown (30 s) has passed since it.

branches.effect: false: false; true: now - openedAt < cooldown

units.does: Counts one timeout; when the count is at or past threshold and the breaker is not open at `now`, (re)opens it at `now`. A timeout while open does not move openedAt.

branches.cond: timeouts >= threshold and not open now
